deep_dive.title: Controlling Embedding Spaces with Text-Conditioned Transformations
deep_dive.abstract: Multimodal embedding spaces in models like CLIP enable powerful capabilities such as semantic similarity retrieval and cross-modal zero-shot classification. These embeddings compress high-level semantics into a single vector, which comes at the cost of primarily expressing a dominant semantics like main object while suppressing other important attributes such as camera angle or color tone. We propose a text-conditioned transformation of visual embeddings that makes such attributes explicitly accessible. Given a natural language description of an attribute category (e.g., "color" or "art style"), a network generates an affine transformation that emphasizes the specified attribute. Conditioning on text enables it to learn many attributes simultaneously, accessing them at inference time through an intuitive interface. The network is trained to align transformed embeddings with the frozen latent space, enabling retrieval using existing large-scale embeddings without any re-encoding. When applied to a full set, the same mechanism transforms the latent space for attribute disentanglement tasks such as multi-clustering. By operating directly in latent space, our method provides a unified and efficient framework for controlling embedding spaces, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance across both attribute-based retrieval and multi-attribute organization tasks with near-zero inference cost. Project page: https://joefioresi718.github.io/ControlEmbed_webpage/

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: The paper addresses suppression of color in multimodal embeddings by proposing text-conditioned affine transforms to emphasize specified attributes. It enables explicit control over color and other features in representation spaces, facilitating disentanglement of color and shape.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文解决多模态嵌入空间（如CLIP）中颜色、相机角度等次要属性被压缩的问题，提出文本条件变换，根据自然语言描述的属性类别（如“颜色”或“艺术风格”）动态生成仿射变换，以强调嵌入向量中的特定属性。文本条件化使模型能同时学习多种属性，并通过单次前向传播实现属性操控。实验显示该方法能有效解耦颜色与形状特征，使颜色信息显式可访问，为在表示层面编辑颜色、构建颜色鲁棒模型提供了新机制。相较于传统方法需要针对每种属性单独训练，该框架通过文本条件实现了参数高效的属性操控，并验证了其在多个属性上的泛化能力。这一能力为后续的下游任务，如图像检索和零样本分类中的细粒度控制，奠定了基础。

deep_dive.title: LoRA for Gender-Inclusive Rewriting and Activation Steering for Counter-Narrative Generation
deep_dive.abstract: Gender-inclusive language generation seeks to transform biased text into inclusive alternatives while preserving semantic meaning and contextual coherence. This paper presents the IHLC system for the LT-EDI 2026 Shared Task, addressing both gender-inclusive rewriting and counter-narrative generation. For gender-inclusive rewriting, we employ parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning, achieving an official score of 80.00%. Our primary contribution is a compute-efficient inference-time representation engineering approach for counter-narrative generation. We derive a principal steering direction from contrastive hidden-state activations using principal component analysis (PCA) and inject it into the intermediate representations of Gemma-3-4B-it during inference, enabling behavioral steering toward inclusive responses without modifying model weights. Combined with constrained prompting, this approach produces polite and contextually appropriate counter-narratives, achieving an official score of 78.12%. We further present a manual analysis of steering behavior, identifying key failure modes including semantic drift, residual bias leakage, layer sensitivity, over-steering, and text degeneration. Our findings highlight both the practical potential and current limitations of activation steering as a lightweight alternative to parameter updates for controllable and socially aligned language generation.
